shadows.name: nav-active
shadows.purpose: The active item in the side menu.

shadows.name: floating
shadows.purpose: Menus and the phone drawer only.

motion.name: control
motion.purpose: Colour transitions on buttons, inputs, rows.

components.name: Primary button
components.description: The one main action on a view.
components.css: .ds-btn { height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: #171715; color: #fff; font: 500 13px Outfit, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-btn:hover { background: rgb(23 23 21 / 0.85); }

components.name: Input
components.html: <input class="ds-input" placeholder="Search by name or handle">
components.css: .ds-input { height: 32px; padding: 6px 10px; border: 1px solid #d6d0c1; border-radius: 6px; font: 400 13px Outfit, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #171715; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #f75115; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgb(247 81 21 / 0.2); }

components.name: Score badge
components.description: Creator Score out of 100, tinted by band.
components.css: .ds-score { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 24px; min-width: 36px; padding: 0 6px; border-radius: 5px; background: #d3fdd9; color: #068116; font: 600 13px Outfit, system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

narrative.northStar: The data is the loudest thing on the page.
narrative.overview: A compact, data-first working tool in the family of Modash, HypeAuditor and Linear, wearing the Vernacular brand: Alabaster side menu, Eerie Black actions, Orange only on what is active or measured.
keyCharacteristics: Status colour always with a word

rules.name: Orange is a pointer, not a paint
rules.body: It marks what is active or measured; never large fills or more than one button.

rules.name: Weight before size
rules.body: Rank is carried by weight and colour first; nothing is larger than 24px except the sign-in headline.

dos: Do put numbers in tables and strips
Do write status in words next to its colour
Do keep one primary button per view
donts: Don't add shadows, gradients or pills
Don't show team-only data on client views
